name: bws-agents
description: Agents tab: every subagent of this session as a live, coloured card in the dashboard (status, type, model, task, elapsed, tool count, last tools, tokens, final answer), running ones first, with a summary strip and a stall flag when an agent makes no tool call for a while. /subagents opens it.

stallMinutes.title: Stall after (minutes)
stallMinutes.description: Flag a running subagent that has made no tool call for this many minutes. 0 turns the flag off.
